name: PSD15
basis: Its manual calls the PSD15 "an off-grid solar controller" that operates "3-phase" "(AC) motor loads up to 1.5HP from solar photovoltaic (PV) power" (doc-ad792b6bb4700d48e2ae347798e185bb, p4) and rates "Maximum Output Current: 7 Arms (3-phase motors)" (p5), with no battery; it converts PV to AC for a pump motor, not a charge controller.
